ITEM 1 | Pale green leafy greens, torn into irregular pieces with ruffled edges and lighter white-green midribs, coated in a creamy pale dressing with visible sheen; covers roughly 45% of the plate in a mound about 3 cm tall, sitting at the left-center of the plate | 150
ITEM 2 | Small golden-tan toasted bread cubes, roughly 1-1.5 cm, with crisp-looking browned edges, scattered among the greens | 12
ITEM 3 | Shaved or grated pale off-white cheese flakes, slightly translucent edges, scattered over and among the greens | 10
ITEM 4 | Creamy pale dressing coating the leaves, glossy with a light sheen, pooled lightly between leaves | 20
ITEM 5 | Pizza slice with a red tomato sauce base and a single round pepperoni disc, about 1 cm thick, with melted pale cheese showing light browning spots and a golden crust edge; sits at the lower right of the plate, about 8 x 6 cm footprint | 75
ITEM 6 | Second pizza slice piece beneath the first, with red sauce visible at the edge, melted pale cheese with light browning, golden crust, about 7 x 4 cm footprint, partially overlapping the first slice | 60
